Preserve existing measurement, failure-repair, security, and private-launch gates. After the CTO releases capacity, retain only the canonical allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement, measured against its evidenced 61 affiliate clicks for 2026-09-21. Do not claim revenue, ROI, conversion lift, or causal impact.

The GitHub signals remain research-only. MarkItDown and shadcn/ui have bounded lab evidence and permissive license metadata, but production security, dependency maintenance, content rights, and fleet-specific outcome evidence remain incomplete. Defer both prototypes until capacity clears and CTO validation is authorized.
